title: VLEngagement: A Dataset of Scientific Video Lectures for Evaluating Population-based Engagement
reasoning: The paper focuses on creating a dataset to predict user engagement with scientific video lectures. Its domain is educational data mining and recommender systems. It does not contain any components related to the evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
